answer: In this PoA design, each agent identity is bound to a remotely attested enclave measurement, MRENCLAVE, and certified through the hardware vendor’s trust chain. A verifier accepts votes only when the live TEE proves that measurement and controls the matching key; copying software or spawning virtual machines cannot reproduce the hardware-backed identity. Therefore, Sybil expansion requires purchasing additional physical silicon, while voyage, saffron, and beacon are merely protocol data.
